mapper.sql: C.CI_SN, C.CI_SE_CD, C.CI_TTL, C.IMG_FILE_ID, C.SORT_SEQ, C.USE_YN, C.DEL_YN, C.REG_DT, C.RGTR_NM, C.MDFCN_DT, C.MDFR_NM, C.DEL_DT, C.DLTR_NM, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = C.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_URL, ( SELECT F.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = C.IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FILE_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM HMPG_CI C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.CI_SE_CD = #{ciSeCd} ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ ASC, C.CI_SN ASC
SELECT FROM HMPG_CI C WHERE C.CI_SN = #{value} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM HMPG_CI WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND CI_SE_CD = #{ciSeCd}
mapper.update: UPDATE HMPG_CI SET CI_SE_CD = #{ciSeCd}, CI_TTL = #{ciTtl}, IMG_FILE_ID = #{imgFileId}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_NM = #{mdtr} WHERE CI_SN = #{ciSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE HMPG_CI SET USE_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND CI_SE_CD = #{ciSeCd} AND CI_SN <> #{keepCiSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
